title_sq: Apartament 2+1 me verande te Univers City
description_sq:
Ofrohet per shitje apartament te tipologjise 2+1 me verande ne kompleksin Univers City.
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 149.88 m2, nga te cilat: siperfaqe bruto jane 90.92 m2, siperfaqe neto 77.25 m2 dhe siperfaqe verande jane 58.96 m2.
title_en: 2+1 apartment with veranda in Univers City
description_en: A 2+1 apartment with a veranda is offered for sale in the Univers City complex. The apartment has a total area of ​​149.88 m2, of which: gross area is 90.92 m2, net area is 77.25 m2 and veranda area is 58.96 m2.
